item.title: [PARQUET-2247] Fail-fast if CapacityByteArrayOutputStream write overflow
item.description: The bytesUsed of CapacityByteArrayOutputStream may overflow when writing some large byte data, resulting in parquet file write corruption.

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

Because `CapacityByteArrayOutputStream#size` may be negative.
